cases.task: Read calculator.py and explain why add(2, 3) is incorrect.

script.text: calculator.py uses subtraction instead of addition.

cases.task: Fix add in calculator.py to add its operands. Preserve support for negative and fractional values.

arguments.patch:
--- a/calculator.py
+++ b/calculator.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def add(left, right):
-    return left - right
+    return left + right
